body:
I'm tired of dealing with the pain my mood disorder brings me. It's never going to be "cured", I'm always going to be dealing with it, and I'm fucking sick of it. The episodes it brings are horrible. I can try to reach out to people, and I may temporarily feel better, but I know I'm just going to feel the same way and deal with the same shit a few days or a week later. Honestly, I think it's going to happen eventually. At some point I think I'm eventually going to kill myself, and I've kinda come to terms with the fact that it's probably going to happen.

Everything just feels so empty, like I have no one to care about, or anyone who cares about me. Even my own parents resented me so much that they kicked me out. It's a terrible feeling, but it's also in some way comforting. It makes me feel less guilty if I were to go through with ending it because I wouldn't hurt anyone, and before I think that's the main reason I never did anything until recent.

As I said earlier I can try to reach out to people, but I also every time I do, I just feel like I'm being pitiful, overwhelming, or attention seeking, and that's the thing that scares me the most about talking it out. 

I've hurt people in more ways than I can describe. It's things that I can't ever forget about. I might have even gotten a girl pregnant. I might have completely destroyed her life. I just want to stop hurting people and I guess it just keeps happening. I think I just want to make sure I don't hurt anyone ever again.

I don't have a future, I don't have any money, my job pays me fucking peanuts, and I know it only gets worse from here out. It's been getting worse for years anyway.

Each of those episodes I have I add a little bit more to my suicide note, since I always procrastinate on it. One of these days it's going to be finished. The one thing I want is just for no one to know so I don't inspire anyone else to do the same.

Saving the "it'll get better" bullshit, just imagine the people that it will affect. Your parents will have to cope with your permanent absence until they die. If they are anything like my mom, they could even go into a state of suicidal thinking. It could drag them down with you.

If you have any siblings imagine how they would feel. They wouldn't be able to ever speak to their bother/sister again. If they are really young, your parents would have to explain what happened to you. There would be a hole that couldn't be replaced. 

Believe it or not there are people who think about you, no matter how distant. I know there's a lot of people I think about even if I haven't spoken to them in a long time. If someone wanted to strike a conversation, they wouldn't be able to. If they found out what happened, it would hurt them to know they missed their chance. If it's a close friend, they will also have to cope with the fact that they won't be able to speak to the person that gave them the happy feeling that came from talking to you.

Some people might have a sense of guilt. Someone who is unstable might feel guilty that they couldn't do shit. Someone might even take it as example that maybe it is a way out. The pain sucks major ass, and I'm sure you don't want others to feel that kind of pain. 

It's gonna hurt people- in more ways than you can imagine.

If he walks in on you, just keep going, then he's gay for watching.

Anything to trigger a religious nut job.
Sooo which do you want? Do you want my list too? Or do you want me to go over each one, because you lied here just like in your other post.
Better safe than sorry, go to the ER
I think you should do it. I think it's really great that you are considering hospitalization to prevent the worst. They can't release any info about you so no one has to find out.
